title.zh: 修正第968号法案（题为“废止第370号与第399号法案（关于减少保和省市镇数量）并把该省现存三十五个市镇减至三十二个”的法案）的法案
title.en: AN ACT AMENDING ACT NUMBERED NINE HUNDRED AND SIXTY-EIGHT, ENTITLED "AN ACT REPEALING ACTS NUMBERED THREE HUNDRED AND SEVENTY AND THREE HUNDRED AND NINETY-NINE RELATIVE TO THE REDUCTION OF THE NUMBER OF MUNICIPALITIES IN THE PROVINCE OF BOHOL, AND REDUCING THE THIRTY-FIVE EXISTING MUNICIPALITIES IN SAID PROVINCE TO THIRTY-TWO.
title.orig: AN ACT AMENDING ACT NUMBERED NINE HUNDRED AND SIXTY-EIGHT, ENTITLED "AN ACT REPEALING ACTS NUMBERED THREE HUNDRED AND SEVENTY AND THREE HUNDRED AND NINETY-NINE RELATIVE TO THE REDUCTION OF THE NUMBER OF MUNICIPALITIES IN THE PROVINCE OF BOHOL, AND REDUCING THE THIRTY-FIVE EXISTING MUNICIPALITIES IN SAID PROVINCE TO THIRTY-TWO.
title.vi: Đạo luật sửa đổi Đạo luật Số 968 về bãi bỏ Đạo luật Số 370 và Đạo luật Số 399 liên quan đến việc giảm số lượng đô thị ở Tỉnh Bohol và giảm ba mươi lăm đô thị hiện có ở tỉnh này xuống ba mươi hai
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแก้ไขพระราชบัญญัติฉบับที่ 968 ว่าด้วยการยกเลิกพระราชบัญญัติฉบับที่ 370 และฉบับที่ 399 ที่เกี่ยวข้องกับการลดจำนวนเทศบาลในจังหวัดโบฮอล และลดเทศบาลที่มีอยู่สามสิบห้าแห่งในจังหวัดนั้นลงเหลือสามสิบสองแห่ง
title.id: Undang-Undang tentang Perubahan Undang-Undang Nomor 968 mengenai Pembatalan Undang-Undang Nomor 370 dan Nomor 399 terkait Pengurangan Jumlah Kotamadya di Provinsi Bohol serta Pengurangan Tiga Puluh Lima Kotamadya yang Ada di Provinsi tersebut menjadi Tiga Puluh Dua
title.ms: Akta bagi Pindaan Akta Nombor 968 berkenaan Pembatalan Akta Nombor 370 dan Akta Nombor 399 berkaitan Pengurangan Bilangan Perbandaran di Wilayah Bohol serta Pengurangan Lima Puluh Tiga Perbandaran yang Ada di Wilayah tersebut kepada Tiga Puluh Dua

text.en:
Act Numbered Nine hundred and sixty-eight, entitled "An Act repealing Acts Numbered three
hundred and seventy and Three hundred and ninety-nine relative to the reduction of the number of
municipalities in the Province of Bohol, and reducing the thirty-five existing municipalities in said province
to thirty-two," is hereby amended by striking out of the title and of the first paragraph of section one the
word "thirty-two" and substituting therefor, in both instances, the word "thirty-three."

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, November 27, 1903.
